name: reecopedia
description: Regulatory search engine for EU textile sustainability law: ESPR (EU) 2024/1781, Digital Product Passport, CSRD, CBAM, EU ETS, CWA 18291 (CIRPASS-2) and JRC preparatory studies. Answers are grounded in retrieved passages with source citations (document, page). Free remote MCP server, no account and no API key.
